0. 想玩爽玩同类型同题材的肉鸽，建议去玩《新星漂移》 1. 很恶心，有防sl机制，游戏会在你死的瞬间优先保存。本来就是碎片化时间打打肉鸽，现在一个个的肉鸽游戏倒是好的不学尽搞恶心的，生怕玩家爽了。像苍翼就很好，为什么人家是好评如潮，因为他起码没有像一众傲慢的游戏制作人一样喜欢费尽心思和玩家对抗。 2.除了安全房里那一丝丝得可怜奶量，几乎没有任何回血手段，甚至连血量都不敢给你显示怕你修改了。而你会遇到各种没有前兆的冲击波，以及路边陨石突然变触手打你一巴掌，像路边野狗一样突然就被国道上贴脸刷出的大运创死了。很难想象作者小时候上学路上遇到了什么。 3.游戏设置界面的激活roguelite模式选项，只要激活就无法撤销，并且激活了会限制你成就。没错，不是切换按钮，而是单向永久改变。没错，不是打mod限制你成就，也不是玩的难度不够限制你成就，而是把能让你爽的局外成长这部分给直接给你上锁了。想解锁？可以，但是代价就是你不给跳成就，因为你没有按照作者的想法受尽苦难。这一点更加印证了现在的一众游戏制作人是什么逼样，喜欢教玩家做事，喜欢告诉玩家：”即便你买了我的游戏，你也得听我的。“ 4.制作人自己都没弄清roguelike和roguelite的区别，游戏简介里写roguelike，游戏特色里写roguelite。综上看特色就是想玩roguelite前必须要被制作人先唾口唾沫。

先说结论，不推荐，游戏给人的正反馈极弱，游玩时更多觉得疲惫压力而非爽快好玩。 [h3]怪物设计上 [/h3] 游戏中小怪存在大量神经刀和需要集中精神反应的内容，经常存在房间堆怪导致玩家需要同时注意多处并且反应的场景，而boss又极其的弱而无聊，没有什么存在感。这种前窄后宽的设计通常让我玩完一关后只有被小怪折磨一路的疲惫而并非酣畅战斗的快乐。 [h3]rogue构筑上 [/h3] 游戏中我体验的部分尚未发现可以变化攻击模式的升级，同时局内所得大多是一些毫无用处并且无聊的技能和属性提升，同时技能的升级也不会带来功能性的趣味变化，取而代之的是数值的单调提升。而更无聊的是，游戏在绝大多数时间给予的技能甚至不如纯粹的数值提升，可以说是构筑无用，数值飞升。 [h3]其他杂项 [/h3] 游戏中的资源少得可怜，同时传送到新的房间时会有无法躲避的开门杀导致必定掉血。游戏中存在大量玩家一眼就知道是垃圾的道具，还好游戏每层自带分解技能选项，[spoiler]导致很多时候已经到了最后一层身上只有一个技能[/spoiler]，但也有两方面缺陷，分解获取的资源只有在下一层才有机会转化为战力，也就意味着如果选择分解的选项那带给玩家的将是一整局的负重训练；而若是选择不分解，每层只有一次的分解机会又会浪费，带着一些有点用处但不大的技能也意义不大。 [spoiler]本来是等人的时候想找个游戏打发时间，结果两个小时的游玩只让我觉得疲惫不堪头晕眼花，我不禁思考为什么要花钱去折磨自己，玩的抑郁症要犯了。[/spoiler] ———————————————————————————————— 开发者回复称设计理念设计理念是一款具有挑战性的Roguelike游戏，核心在于技巧提升而非数值成长。我明白开发者的意图，试图做出类魂感觉的rogue地牢游戏。但目前游戏内容似乎已取魂糟粕去魂精华了。这主要体现在boss战斗过于薄弱单调使人无法体会魂类以小胜大的成就感和小怪过多使人体会到即便魂类也会特意避免的类似三狗突脸的设计。我认为按照给出的设计理念更应该减少堆怪同时加强单体数值，强化boss战斗，以此来丰富游戏体验，避免本末倒置。 游戏的底子还是不错的，相信经过更新之后会有更好的游戏体验。

异常无聊，后悔不能退款 build元素是来搞笑的，不是你做几个perk就叫build了，不给发对应的资源，也构不成有意义的组合，这个根本不叫build，叫看脸 发那么匮乏的资源导致你玩了半天玩法上没有任何显著的变化，到第三关了手里也就那么一两个perk，不要说有联动了，能用都谢天谢地吧 战斗抓抓乐初见新鲜，玩多了就是手忙脚乱，你到底是抓还是开火？敌机可不会等你去判断优先级，去想干啥干啥就是挨打，无趣 战斗反馈糟糕，你根本分不清哪些是能吃的，比如爆炸到底怎么样才能不对你造成伤害，时有时无就显得非常诡异 我的评价是为什么不去玩隔壁新星漂移，不要说那是更新完的游戏，就连新星漂移的EA版本都比这个好玩 空有想法，但执行实在过于糟糕

第一次被开发者回复 而且上班前吐槽的下班回来就改进了。玩着体验好了很多，那还说啥呢兄弟（弗雷尔卓德瓶盖），销量+1，给朋友送一个。 8/10 这价钱值得吧我只能说 内容 手感 可玩性还是不赖的 白天我承认是有点红有点大声了 我的 -------------更新于6.7凌晨 本来想耐着性子通完全部内容再评论的，但是作者真的有点对着我的雷区疯狂大力抽射了。 最让我忍受不了的一点是 奖励箱子竟然可以被打爆 而且还可以被怪物打爆 鼻屎大的场景 中后期箱子只要刷在怪脸上 那基本这个房间就白打了 本来这B箱子爆率就低 三五个房间才出一个 还愿意跟怪长一起 我真的红了 怪物锁头性能强悍 其实这也没啥 但是一些蓄力连发的怪物只要你离得不够远 你用闪避躲第一发 第二发是稳吃的 另外为什么要在一款弹幕射击游戏里 每一关都塞他妈这么多正面无敌的怪物啊 绕背-6 -6刮一轮还打不掉 还得继续跟怪绕 无人机、受伤后XXX和尾焰系列的perk真的是来搞笑的，受伤后就这个只能挨三五下的脆皮机体，一把到死就触发个三五次还是持续三五秒，尾焰要拿命飞到敌人脸上蹭。无人机出来被我自己两下全打死，2025年还在做友军伤害的游戏真的有点，那我到底是停手让无人机打 还是把无人机打掉自己打 打不打呢？ 打完第一次巨兽之后 怪物血量翻倍带霸体 我还是-6-6 用近战就是玻璃大炮 秒不了怪就必吃锁头弹幕 我不敢想后面 发育穷 机体脆 输出软 性能笨 底子真的蛮好的 但是为啥要搞这么多反人类的设定呢 一堆陷阱 一堆打不开的光球 一堆拿不到的宝箱 一堆霸体锁头的怪物 一堆买不起的perk 6/10 我自己能凑合玩 本来想给朋友送一个的 我再品品要不要给朋友尝尝

Was a really solid game before the 1.0 update, for some reason the devs got it in their head to remove a bunch of the features that made the game fun. I have absolutely no explanation for why they did this. Might still be fun if you've never experienced the early access, but as a shortlist: - One of the game's main mechanics is the gravity gun(?). In the early access you could rip small pieces off of large enemies, which meant alongside shooting them or throwing things at them, you had three options for dealing with them. The variability made combat very fun, because you could deal with various enemies in different ways, and switching as you liked meant more interesting combat. You could not rip pieces off of certain elite enemies, which I, when asked for feedback, pointed out was an extremely unfun way to increase difficulty. The developer response to this was to remove this ability. (Note; I have not played the 1.0 extensively. Given all of my progress was wiped when the update came out, it's possible they've locked this ability behind some upgrade or another. Regardless of whether it was removed or locked behind an upgrade, you should not prevent players access to HALF OF YOUR MAIN GIMMICK. This is not rocket science.) - You can now apparently only have like five upgrades at a time. This is a roguelite. The upgrades are half the fun. Why would you get rid of upgrades in a roguelite. I just. Again, this is not rocket science. - You can level up upgrades. The way it used to work is that you'd get essentially stat points, and each one would let you level up that kind of upgrade. So a damage stat up would let you improve an upgrade that gave you area damage, or a movement speed stat up would let you level up an upgrade that improved your dash, etc. They have replaced this with an extremely basic system in which upgrades are leveled up with basic tokens that do nothing else. Why would you REMOVE features from your game? Once again I simply don't have words. - This game had the actual buttery-smoothest gameplay I have ever experienced in the early access. In the middle of combat I would do spins just because fighting in this game genuinely felt like dancing, like you were just having a grand time, and also raining destruction on your enemies. Somehow in the 1.0 that is no longer the case. I have no idea how they managed this, it might have something to do with strengthening the aim assist? But the game feels stiff now. One of the reviews featured on the steam page talks about how good the game feels to play, and that WAS true, I would have agreed absolutely, but they just ruined that and I don't even have any idea how. That was probably the main appeal of the game, other than the upgrades WHICH THEY ALSO RUINED. I just. Don't understand. Like my overwhelming question here is just why? All of these things worked fine or great before the 1.0, and they just... decided to make them worse? They removed a large part of their main gimmick from the game, significantly lowered player agency, made their upgrade/level up system less interesting and more basic, and somehow ♥♥♥♥♥♥ up their gameplay's main appeal. Like. The last one could have been by accident, but three of these are obviously purposeful and I cannot imagine why you would do any of them. Who thought these were good ideas? I assume removing half the gimmick and limiting how many upgrades you have is a ham-fisted attempt to increase difficulty, something they clearly do not need to do because in the five days since the update there have been SIX BALANCE PATCHES to make the game easier. You ruined your game to make it harder and now you're running around like headless chickens lowering enemy health and damage? What the ♥♥♥♥ is wrong with you, genuinely? 'Feedback says enemies are too hard at later levels' do you think just maybe that might be because players can no longer scale past a certain point?? Could that be the solution to this grand mystery, perhaps?? Maybe the reason they can't beat hard enemies anymore is because they're not allowed to get stronger after a certain point. No, that's crazy, forcibly preventing the player from getting stronger while enemies continue to get more powerful wouldn't make the enemies harder to beat, that's crazy talk. Sigh. I got a little carried away there. Potential buyers: This game is not... bad, really. It's just disappointing for me personally because it used to be so much better. You could totally play it and have fun, it's just a basic ♥♥♥♥♥ roguelite, now. Developers, if you read this: I'm very sorry, I really don't like hurting people's feelings, but. I just have nothing nice to say about you. Why have you done this? Are you just too stupid to realize how bad these changes are? That's not an insult, I'm genuinely baffled and sad. This game had so much potential, and not only was it not realized, it was made worse, and it was made worse ON PURPOSE. You didn't badly implement good ideas, you looked at this game and decided to implement changes that actively damaged every aspect of the game's appeal. You limited upgrades and downgraded the upgrade system, you REMOVED HALF OF THE MAIN GIMMICK(can't get over this), and you made the game not feel good to play. What's left? What am I supposed to enjoy about this game when you've made the upgrades, the combat, and the overall gameplay less fun? I was so ready for the 1.0 to make the game even better, and you did this. Why?

既不rogue也不like，大多数时间都在重复之前的关卡，而且想快速到目前的关卡速通就拿不到提升，想拿提升就得费时间清全图，大多数精力都消耗在了无意义的重复清关中，而且前期很难得到伤害提升，打到中期就有点2D魂游的感觉了，容错率很低，而一旦死亡，惩罚性比魂还高，起码魂不会没有存档点要求你每次死亡都要从头开始推所有的地区。综合缺点，前期提升慢而且吃运气，没有存档点需要重复清图，清过的图没有地图没办法直接去拿提升的属性或者技能，惩罚性是我见过的所有游戏里面几乎最高的，直接回到初始点，虽然保留了一些碎片，但是速通前面的关卡的话没办法换取属性提升。

great fun, good mechanics, but boring. having to run through every single level, knowing that the slightest mistake with your healthpool means you have to seriously play safe just made it feel arduous to endlessly restart because on level 2 you had a bad run in with a boss or something, and knowing your hp just wont last through how hard things hit on level 5. if health was more available, making mistakes not as punishing, the game would be a real banger.

Excellent shoot 'em up. I couldn't put it down when my bro got it for me. The gameplay slightly reminds me of Binding of Isaac, but it's got the fastness and wobliness of a really fluid (liquid, really) shoot 'em up with just the right number of roguelite trappings. All the weapons are relatively easy to unlock, but combined with the types of hulls you can have... lots of things can happen in the simulation. I still consider myself pretty bad in this game, but gotta hand it that it is darn addictive. Thank God Most High I mostly play it high otherwise I probably wouldn't own the screen I'm typing this through.

这游戏也玩了二十多个小时了，今天刚刚通关新版本下的最终boss，不过目前还没有全收集的打算。 如果要我给这个游戏归类的话，其实不太好说，它有一点roguelike的要素，但是又有所不同，感觉更像是动作类的爽游，但是过程中又需要你动脑子去思考技能的搭配并合理规划升级路线，这让玩了不少rogue类游戏的我感觉眼前一亮。 而且这个游戏有一个让我印象很深的点就是对于bug的应用。不知道大家对bug的开发到了什么程度，反正我目前发现bug引爆之后可以麻痹敌人、破开一些箱子、破开一些道路，不仅如此，如果你在商店引爆bug，它还可以刷新商店的货品，甚至可以把商店的bug和一起引爆，还能让升级令牌暂时变得免费（然后就会像bug一样爆开，可能说明它和bug有类似的本质），甚至还能让在售的治疗物品升级并变得免费，甚至有时候会出现真正的bug，就很符合这个道具的名字。 我看不少人说这个游戏很难，我目前感觉新版本下的难度已经削弱了很多了，正常游玩的话可能无伤比较困难，但是我选一些血量比较厚的战机通关是非常容易的，而且操作上很容易就给我一种爽感。 不过要说缺点还是有的，目前游戏的剧情上描绘比较模糊，属于是有剧情但是让人看着有点摸不着头脑，而且关卡的变化比较少。建议开发者之后可以把剧情完善一下，比如做一些随机出现的隐藏房间，里面有关于剧情的线索，同时最后可以做出一个或者多个结局。 ————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————— 最新更新后的补充： 感觉更新之后的内容还是很不错的，能感受到开发者的诚意，之前的一些小问题也得到了修复，还增加了不少新的玩法和武器，总体下来体验很不错。而且感觉现在的难度比以前还更低了，建议开发者再增加一些难度梯度，现在玩起来没什么挑战性了，这也可能是因为我还没尝试无尽模式和挑战模式的原因。总之很感谢开发者做出了这么好玩的游戏，在最近这几天的游戏荒里面又激起了我对游戏的兴趣。
THE THROWING MECHANIC IS SO GOOD. I spent an entire run just chucking asteroids at things instead of shooting. It worked. 10/10 would throw space rocks again.

《故障星系》是一款太空题材的肉鸽射击类游戏，玩家将操控一艘小飞船，携带不同类型的武器，搭配武器自带的技能跟抓取投掷基础技巧，深入崩塌中的星系探索，击败各式各样的巨型BOSS。 本作体量不大，所占体积仅1G不到，然而却出人意料的有趣。 1.果冻一样的太空世界 游戏采用传统地牢闯关的模式，玩家将在随机生成的不同房间中探索，与各类敌人战斗、开启战利品宝箱，或用获得的货币在商店购物，不断武装强化自己。每个房间的质感做得蛮有意思的，像果冻般blingbling的Q弹软糯。玩家不仅能挤进去躲避子弹，还能将子弹射入后利用反作用力弹射出来攻击敌人。就连在各个房间之间进行穿行也会呈现一样的视觉效果，整个过程就像在给眼睛做spa，看着十分的解压。 2.丝滑的操控手感 开过飞船的人都知道，真正的飞船操控起来特别的复杂，光是说明书的厚度就能把人砸倒在地（笑）。扯远了，作为肉鸽爽游，本作自然不会在操控上为难玩家，甚至做到了很亲民的程度，无论你是否有过相关游戏经验都能快速上手。飞船性能也很强，初始移动速度就比较快，除了自己射，还能拉着小伙伴一起射（召唤友军单位）。更能抓取小型的物体或者敌舰进行投掷攻击，且投掷手感极佳，比主武器射击还要来得带劲！ 3.多样的解锁内容 虽然游戏体量小，但是可解锁内容不少（通过蓝图跟货币来解锁）。每次解锁的新武器因配备有不同的技能，所有能带来不一样的游玩体验。游戏地图支持随时传送，游玩节奏也得到了加快，使得解锁起来也不是很肝。 总的来说，这款游戏好看、好玩又解压，目前打折后的售价很便宜，性价比这一块还是不错的。 [quote] 加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ADZZW]爱の榨汁屋[/url]&关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34815366/]爱の鉴赏家[/url]，用爱品鉴世间作品，用心流淌真情实感。 [/quote]

I remember a class where I was classmate with a game developer, and I recall asking him one day what games he played. That developer then looked at me as if I were some kind of degenerate and, indignant, told me he didn’t play games—he only developed them. As if I were an addict asking a drug dealer which of his narcotics he used. Which, I believe, explains mistakes like Galactic Glitch. Because the developer didn’t play his own game. This isn’t a game developed for the fulfillment of another, like the Indian Brahman’s dream: this is a game developed for the delusions of self-indulgent capitalism. And I admit I bought it because I believed I was getting a game from the same developer as the excellent 3030 Deathwar, when, in fact, Crunchy Leaf Games was the publisher of 3030 Deathwar. Galactic Glitch fails in so many ways that I was surprised by the number of positive reviews. But not until I realized that the positive reviews come from people who played for only a few hours. Because it gets more frustrating as you progress. It’s a game in which, despite all the possibilities of the genre, the developer thought or believed it would be more interesting to hurl asteroids at enemies, like in a tragicomic cosmic bowling game, rather than firing weapons. And, among the available weapons, only one or two are useful, just like the powers: the more powers you unlock, the more the game limits itself because most of them are useless. The players’ achievement percentages speak for themselves. But the degenerate is the developer.

I can't fault anything in the sound department either, although I'm not a huge fan of a couple music tracks but it's due to personal taste. Scratches that 'roguelite itch' in a clever and deceptively simple package. What it lacks in depth of strategy is more than made up for by the satisfaction of mastering survival in the frenetic action sequences which are punctuated by meaningful (if limited) choices. Note: I often leave the app running in the background often enough that my total hours skew way longer than the game actually takes to reach true ending. I would say that its somewhere between 10 and 15 hours if you scrutinize upgrades methodically and explore every nook and cranny the way I did. Perhaps longer for a newcomer to the genre and it can be conquered faster if you prefer to speed run through your games. I don't remember what I paid for the title, but I am sure it was on sale. Totally worth it on sale, probably worth it at full price too.

Seemed a little lackluster and clunky at first, but once you get an understanding of the controls, you'll find that this action-packed roguelike has some incredibly solid fundamental mechanics and synergies. Ripping apart an enemy ship using their gun against them, and then throwing that same dismantled gun into another enemy's face is so incredibly satisfying on it's own... I'm just surprised this game doesn't have more traction in the market. TLDR, give it a try. Pay full price if you'd like to support a small dev team, or buy it on sale if you're on a budget. It's worth your time if you're looking for something casual but fun.

You might get a few hours of fun out of this game while you're figuring things out, but there really isn't much depth to be found. I won't complain much about the story being subpar (though it really is), because the biggest issue by far is the lack of balance. Both in terms of builds (there are elements that the moment you use them turn out to be so obviously superior that you've no reason to ever go for anything else) and overall gameplay (once you have a semi-competent build, you can annihilate normal combat rooms, even without meta-upgrades and the only way the bosses can even try to provide a challenge is through bullet hell attacks that your ship is to slippery to handle with precision). The gravity gun, while a neat gimmick at first, also doesn't have much depth. If you build for it, then all you do in combat is fly around spamming the grab and release button at every opportunity with zero thought. And that becomes especially apparent in challenges that take away your normal weapons.
